rationale_overall: At cap=1 the bar to displace the sole holding is extremely high, and nothing this quarter clears it. NVDA's Q3 FY2024 print (Nov 21 2023) showed record revenue of $18.12B (+206% YoY) and record data-center revenue of $14.51B (+279% YoY), confirming the AI wave is still in buildup/surge despite the Oct 17 tightening of US AI-chip export controls to China (already digested by quarter-end). Pass-1 across every named wave surfaced no single ticker with a Q4-dated catalyst strong enough to justify a sole-exposure swap (NuScale carried negative dated news; IBM's Condor quantum chip is real but IBM is a diversified value name). Hold NVDA.
